Politics · India

Delhi Police Bars Parliament March Amid Protester Gatherings

Hundreds of protesters gathered at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi on July 19 for a planned march to Parliament, organized by CJP. The Delhi Police issued prohibitory orders, banning marches and tightening security, stating no permission was sought or granted for the demonstration. The protest comes amid calls for the education minister's resignation over exam paper leaks, with one activist's fast continuing in hospital.
